extraction.Name: Julia Mengel formerly Julia Ramis Junior
extraction.Refused/Protested: Not that I remember. While I did not protest the patent at the time of delivery, I really did not want it on account of the taxes and my inability to lease the land for any more than the taxes.
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: I deeded it to my husband as he is a banker and could better handle it.
extraction.Buyer: Deeded to her husband (a banker); realized $3000.00 net
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: taxes and my inability to lease the land for any more than the taxes; taxes for the years 1921 1922 1923 and 1924 amounted to $320.52 and were to the expense of about $325.00 for breaking and fencing which would have not been necessary had the patent not have been issued
extraction.NOTES: Patent mailed to allottee; she did not go to the agency to receive it. Had land broken at expense, followed by crop failures; land did not bring enough to pay taxes and expenses. Requested refund of expenses incurred. Two children dependent; children sent to school at own expense without government assistance. Allottee felt issuance of patent was 'in a measure an injustice.' Subscribed and sworn before Jas. W. Cross, Notary Public (commission expires 4-28-32), on the 5th day of May 1929.
